meta.coverage: TWSE + TPEx current common-stock issuer universe; non-financial discovery screen.

rules.earnings_gate: positive latest reported EPS OR revenue YoY >= 35% with EARNINGS_VERIFY flag

market_cap.reason: Do not impose an asymmetric market-cap hard filter unless an authoritative comparable field is available for both TWSE and TPEx.

rules.research_funnel: Full TWSE/TPEx issuer universe → quantitative screen → Top 50 → deep research Top 10 + incumbent VERIFY/BUY → Alpha Engine Buy Gate
rules.universe_policy: Deep research queue is Top 10 screen candidates plus incumbent BUY/VERIFY names; screen ranking never directly creates BUY CANDIDATE.

notes: This file no longer represents a manually curated seed universe.
The first successful market-scan workflow replaces the bootstrap state with live Top 50 and Top 10 queues.
If an official market source is degraded, promotion from that market is disabled instead of silently using stale data.
